market_outlook.short_term: Bullish but fragile. S&P 500 nears record on AI/tech strength and Magnificent Seven rally. October acceleration expected. Key risk: S&P breadth weakness, yield curve compression, and political noise. Oil range-bound on Iran/Saudi dynamics. Natgas breakout to $3.25 likely. Crypto momentum continues.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with structural tailwinds: AI capex cycle, energy transition infrastructure, fixed income re-rating, and record ETF inflows ($1.5T). Headwinds: US-China decoupling, political polarization, and potential mid-cycle correction if S&P breadth fails. 6-12mo: expect 8-12% equity upside with 15-20% volatility range.
